extracted_claim: Tracy uses zone-based profiling via macros. ZoneScoped creates a scoped zone (RAII). ZoneNamedN(varname, name, active) creates named zone. ZoneTransient creates dynamic-name zone. Zones support: ZoneText/ZoneName (text labels), ZoneColor (custom color), ZoneValue (numeric value). When TRACY_ENABLE is not defined, all macros compile to nothing (zero overhead). SourceLocationData stores: name, function, file, line, color.
implementation_relevance: HSE has no profiling. Tracy is the standard frame profiler for game engines.

topic: Tracy Frame Marks and Memory Tracking
extracted_claim: FrameMark sends frame boundary. FrameMarkNamed(name) for named frames. FrameMarkStart/End for manual frame segments. FrameImage(data, w, h, offset, flip) captures frame buffer. Memory tracking: TracyAlloc(ptr, size), TracyFree(ptr), TracyAllocN(ptr, size, name), TracyFreeN(ptr, name). Lock profiling: TracyLockable(type, var), TracySharedLockable(type, var). Plot data: TracyPlot(name, val), TracyPlotConfig(name, type, step, fill, color). Message logging: TracyMessage(txt, size). Fiber support: TracyFiberEnter/Leave.
implementation_relevance: Frame marks enable frame time analysis. Memory tracking detects leaks. Lock profiling detects contention.
